integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hand-painted 2D anime cel animation: clean confident linework, flat cel shading with soft painted backgrounds, rich pink and teal neon light, steady diagonal rain and wet reflective rooftops at night. The courier girl has a short black bob, a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down and a dark green messenger bag; the three ninjas wear all black with red scarves over their faces. Characters keep the same proportions, outlines and colors in every frame. The shot begins exactly on Picture 1: the girl sprinting across the empty wet rooftop from the lower left, looking back over her shoulder, the wooden water tower with its ladder on the left, the steel zipline cable on the right edge, the stairwell hut with the red door in the background. At about one second the three ninjas drop out of the rainy sky one after another and land crouched on the roof of the stairwell hut. At about two and a half seconds the girl skids to a stop in the middle of the roof, cornered, catching her breath. The shot settles into the final composition of Picture 2 and holds: the girl standing in the center foreground seen from behind, the wooden water tower with its ladder on the left, the steel zipline cable on the right edge, the stairwell hut with the red door in the background, and the three ninjas crouched on the hut roof.

overall_soundscape: Heavy rain, fast splashing footsteps, three soft thuds as the ninjas land, a skid on wet concrete, her hard breathing, the distant city.
